# Combination Lock and Chain
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Tap \[F\] at the driver's side of a bike or other doorless vehicle to lock it. Its padlock's code opens it, and it locks again when the rider gets off.*

| Property | Value |
|:--|:--|
| Size | 1 |
| Category | Other item |
| Hit points | 1 |

## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Crafted, see below.

## Crafting

**Made by**

- By hand: [Chain](Chain) + [Combination Padlock](Combination-Padlock)

## Scrap

Worth 1 [Scrap Metal](Scrap-Metal) in a Scrap Machine, see [Scrap](Scrap).
